name: Argomon
main_effect:
When digivolving into this card, by suspending up to 5 Tamers, for each Tamer suspended by this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
[Opponent's Turn] None of your opponent's Tamers can unsuspend.
[On Deletion] If you have 4 or more [Argomon] in your trash, you may play 1 level 6 [Argomon] from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By suspending 1 of your [Rhythm], unsuspend this Digimon.
